**Reproduced:** Copy only the exact [manifest](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/blob/7687a35d7522482bd8361d60dbc2589e9afbc81c/package.json) and [lockfile](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/blob/7687a35d7522482bd8361d60dbc2589e9afbc81c/package-lock.json) into a disposable directory. On Linux x64 with the official Node 22.18.0 distribution and bundled npm 10.9.3, run `npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --dry-run`. Same exit 1 and mismatch; both source hashes remain unchanged. The prior Node 24.22.1/npm 11.9.0 dry-run passed on those bytes. This is a toolchain-specific reproducible setup failure; it is not evidence of a tracker mutation or release failure.

**Expected / acceptance:** The committed dependency graph installs frozen on the exact Node 22 closeout toolchain and the other supported runtime lane(s); confirm the real gated workflow proceeds to the read/plan phase. Preserve the frozen-install, audit and tracker guards, and add an exact pinned-toolchain frozen-install regression check. Do not replace npm ci with a mutable install to mask the mismatch.
